purpose: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define recursive Project composition so any Project may contain child Projects and work decomposition remains structurally explicit and cycle-safe. [2] Define explicit parent/child Project composition so arbitrary work decomposition remains recursive while preserving exact identities and preventing hierarchy from implying execution or authority.

value.aggregation_rule: Parent status/progress may be derived from children only by explicit aggregation policy.
value.authority_rule: Parenthood does not automatically grant every participant rights over child Projects or vice versa.
value.containment_rule: Parent/child is explicit containment/relation semantics rather than inferred from presentation order.
value.cycle_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Illegal Project ancestry cycles hard-fail. [2] Project containment cycles hard-fail unless a distinct non-containment relation is explicitly intended.
value.depth_rule: Project depth is conceptually recursive; readers/visualizers may impose bounded traversal without changing canonical structure.
value.leaf_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] A Project with no child Projects is a leaf Project. [2] A leaf Project is a Project with no active child decomposition at the applicable work scope.
value.ordering_rule: Sibling Project order is non-semantic unless explicitly declared.
value.recursive_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] A Project may contain zero or more child Projects. [2] A Project may contain child Projects recursively.
value.relation_rule: Parent/child Project structure uses explicit canonical relations.
value.semantic_rule: Labels such as phase, milestone, task or subtask are roles/classifications of Projects, not new primitive identities.
value.trace_rule: Every child can trace its parent chain and every parent can enumerate declared children.
